title: A Tide for the Promise
author: Coral Villalobos
blurb: Sable Hartwell, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
